recent_articles.title: Important to question those in power to enforce accountability; strong judiciary must: Former judge S Muralidhar | Legal News - The Indian Express

recent_articles.title: Spencer Pratt was a reality show villain. Can he become the mayor of LA?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Spencer Pratt**, a former reality TV star known for his role on "The Hills," is running for mayor of Los Angeles.  A new poll shows him in a tight race with **Karen Bass**, the current mayor, and **Nithya Raman**, a city council member. Pratt's campaign has been fueled by social media attention and fundraising success, despite criticism from opponents who question his lack of experience in government. His message focuses on fixing the city after recent disasters, including the devastating wildfires in 2025, which he blames on **Bass**.  Pratt's unconventional approach to politics, similar to other reality TV stars turned politicians like Donald Trump and Arnold Schwarzenegger, has garnered attention and support from some voters.

recent_articles.title: Singam K Annamalai: BJP's Tamil Nadu Star Rose Fast, Fell Faster
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K Annamalai**, the BJP's most recognizable face in Tamil Nadu, has announced his intention to leave the party. He met with **Nitin Nabin**, the party chief, and other leaders in Delhi, seeking a "cordial" exit.  He cited a lack of future opportunities within the BJP as the reason for his decision. Annamalai's departure follows a strained relationship with the party leadership after disagreements over electoral strategy and alliances. He has been vocal about his dissatisfaction with the AIADMK-BJP alliance and previously expressed discontent with constituency allocations for the upcoming Tamil Nadu Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: The Trump Administration Is at War With Itself Over AI Regulation | WIRED
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Trump** administration is grappling with internal disagreements over a revised executive order on AI regulation.  Following the cancellation of a planned signing ceremony for the original order, key figures like **Susie Wiles**, **Scott Bessent**, and **Sean Cairncross** are attempting to revive it.  However, former AI czar **David Sacks** opposes the proposal, while Trump himself remains a significant obstacle. The White House spokesperson maintains that the administration is striving to balance regulation with innovation, but internal dynamics remain fluid as officials debate the best approach.

recent_articles.title: Why Sardar Azmoun was left out of Iran’s World Cup squad amid political storm
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iran** named their 26-man squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, but striker **Sardar Azmoun** was excluded. The decision sparked controversy as many believe his omission is linked to a social media post he shared in March where he met UAE ruler **Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum**, which angered Iranian authorities at a time of heightened political tensions. While coach **Amir Ghalenoei** cited the need for national unity, many observers believe political factors played a major role in Azmoun's exclusion.

recent_articles.title: Somalia needs a political settlement before it is too late | Opinions | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Somalia is facing a critical political crisis without an agreed path to elections or a political transition. **President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud**’s term expired, and talks between the government and opposition failed, leaving Somalia vulnerable to deeper fragmentation.  The country's fragile state is further strained by insecurity, humanitarian distress, economic fragility, widespread corruption, and shifting geopolitical rivalries. The contested nature of the Somali state itself, with Somaliland seeking independence and other regions breaking ties with the Federal Government, adds to the complexity. **Justin Davis**, the US chargé d’affaires to Somalia, and **Charles King**, the UK’s ambassador, had been attempting to facilitate a political transition roadmap but failed.  The international community must intervene now to prevent Somalia from descending further into political instability.

recent_articles.title: NEET UG Retest June 21 in pen and paper mode: NTA briefs parliament panel amid fresh political storm
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A parliamentary committee meeting examining pen-and-paper versus computer-based testing systems devolved into a political debate over the June 21 NEET-UG retest. **Digvijaya Singh**, chair of the committee, expressed concern about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's personal accountability for preventing another paper leak.  **NTA officials** defended their plan to conduct the re-examination in pen-and-paper format and assured the panel that adequate safeguards were in place. The committee also prevented representatives from a doctors’ body, **United Doctors Front**, from presenting their concerns regarding the NEET-UG examination process.

recent_articles.title: Trump's $1.8 Billion 'Weaponization' Payout Put On Hold After Backlash
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump's** nearly $1.8 billion victim compensation fund, aimed at compensating individuals who alleged government "weaponization," has been put on hold after facing opposition from **Republican senators**. The fund was halted due to concerns over payouts to January 6th Capitol attackers and a lack of support from the White House.  The Justice Department, under acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, is currently reviewing the situation, with some sources suggesting it may be permanently scrapped. Senate Majority Leader John Thune has called for the fund's termination while House Speaker Mike Johnson also participated in discussions about the matter.

recent_articles.title: Five new Supreme Court judges sworn in - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** of India welcomed five new judges on Tuesday, June 2nd, 2026, increasing its total strength to 37.  These appointments follow the Union government's increase in sanctioned judges from 33 to 37, aimed at addressing a backlog of over 93,000 cases. The newly appointed judges include **Sheel Nagu**, former Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana High Court; **Shree Chandrashekhar**, former Chief Justice of Bombay High Court; **Sanjeev Sachdeva**, former Chief Justice of Madhya Pradesh High Court; **Arun Palli**, former Chief Justice of High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh; and Senior Advocate **V.S. Mohana**.  The appointments are part of a larger effort to balance regional representation and improve gender diversity on the Bench, as well as address the court's backlog of cases.

recent_articles.title: US justice department halts 'anti-weaponisation' fund after court ruling
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US Department of Justice (DOJ)** announced it will abide by a court ruling halting the Trump administration's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund, which was intended to compensate individuals alleging unfair treatment by previous administrations. The DOJ disagrees with the decision and maintains the fund was created to address abuse and harm suffered by many people regardless of political affiliation.  The judge temporarily blocked the fund until a hearing on June 12th after two men alleged discrimination in its eligibility criteria. Several Republican lawmakers, Democrats, and even former Vice President Mike Pence have voiced opposition to the fund, calling it a "slush fund" and urging its discontinuation.

recent_articles.title: ‘Cow not animal, it’s revered as mother’: Yogi Adityanath asks clerics to caution followers against any disrespect | Lucknow News - The Indian Express

recent_articles.title: SMOKERS’ CORNER: THE MYTH OF UNITY - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Political analysts argue that a formal rapprochement between the military, government, and Imran Khan is necessary for Pakistan's national unity amidst security threats. However, experts caution against concessions to a populist leader like Khan, citing historical examples of appeasement leading to instability. The 27th Amendment to the Constitution has strengthened the state's authority by centralizing military command and establishing a federal constitutional court, discouraging informal deals with political personalities.  The current government and military establishment believe that national unity should be based on support for the state, not individual leaders, and that seeking dialogue through formal channels is crucial during times of crisis.

recent_articles.title: SMOKERS’ CORNER: THE MYTH OF UNITY - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Political analysts are suggesting a formal rapprochement between the military establishment, government, and Imran Khan is the only viable path forward for Pakistan. They argue that national unity is crucial to address mounting security threats from India, Islamist militants, and Baloch separatists. However, the government and military establishment believe granting concessions to Khan would undermine their authority and create a precedent for future political actors to exploit instability for personal gain.  They view the 27th Amendment, which centralizes military command under the Chief of Defence Forces, as a step towards strengthening the state's position and preventing further internal appeasement. They argue that national unity should be based on support for the state, government, and Constitution rather than a specific political personality. This approach is seen as more effective in addressing Pakistan's current challenges than seeking dialogue with Khan.

recent_articles.title: Tripura Government accommodating fake private universities, Opposition alleges - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Bill to fund US homeland security fails again as concern grows about airport lines | US news | The Guardian

recent_articles.title: As per provision, Nitish Kumar can remain CM for next six months: Bihar Minister Sharwan Kumar - The Hindu

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **US Attorney General Pam Bondi** has been formally summoned to Congress by the **House Oversight Committee**, Chairman James Comer, to answer questions about her handling of the investigation into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The subpoena comes after pressure from lawmakers on both sides of the aisle for the release of all documents related to the probe.  The committee is investigating "possible mismanagement" of the investigation and believes Bondi possesses valuable insight into its handling. **Bondi** has been asked to appear before the committee on April 14th, but the Justice Department maintains that the subpoena is unnecessary and that lawmakers have access to unredacted files.

recent_articles.title: Rayner: government ‘cannot just go through the motions in the face of decline’ | Angela Rayner | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Angela Rayner**, former deputy prime minister, warned **Keir Starmer** that the Labour party's survival is at stake and urged him to not "go through the motions" in the face of declining support.  Rayner criticized the government's proposed immigration changes, arguing they undermine fair play and are un-British, while also condemning opposition parties for stoking fear and division. She called for a Labour government that delivers change and upholds British values. Rayner's comments come amid speculation about her potential leadership bid to replace **Starmer**.

recent_articles.title: Assam MP Pradyut Bordoloi quits Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pradyut Bordoloi**, a Congress MP representing the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat, resigned from his party membership.  He cited feeling sidelined in the party and alleged mistreatment by **Gaurav Gogoi**, the Assam Congress president, as reasons for his decision. The resignation comes after **Bhupen Kumar Borah**, former State president of the **Assam Congress**, switched to the **Bharatiya Janata Party**.  The resignations have raised questions about the future of **Prateek Bordoloi**, his son who is contesting the upcoming Assam Assembly elections as a Congress candidate.

recent_articles.title: Joe Kent: Tulsi Gabbard was asked to fire Joe Kent but she never did, claims Fox News correspondent amid major row - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Joe Kent**, director of the **National Counterterrorism Center**, resigned after criticizing the Trump administration's strike on Iran, citing his inability to support the war.  **Donald Trump** and the White House welcomed Kent's departure, while some MAGA insiders labeled him a "leaker." Fox News correspondent **Aishah Hasnie** claimed that the White House instructed **Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard** to fire Kent but she did not act. Gabbard has remained silent on the matter and hasn't commented since the strikes began.

recent_articles.title: Pam Bondi subpoenaed over Epstein files release by House committee | Pam Bondi | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pam Bondi**, the US attorney general, has been subpoenaed to appear before a House panel investigating the **Department of Justice’s** handling of the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and its release of related files. The move follows growing criticism from lawmakers on both sides of the aisle over compliance with the **Epstein Files Transparency Act**.  The subpoena requests Bondi's testimony on April 14th, following a vote by the House oversight committee to authorize it. The **Department of Justice** has defended its actions and offered to brief the committee, while Democrats have accused Bondi of leading a cover-up.

recent_articles.title: Chief justice John Roberts calls for end to ‘dangerous’ hostility toward judges | John Roberts | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Justice John Roberts** condemned personal attacks on judges, stating that such hostility is "dangerous" and must cease.  His remarks come amid a pattern of criticism from **Donald Trump** and his administration against judges who have ruled against him or his agenda.  Roberts emphasized the importance of respectful discourse regarding judicial decisions while acknowledging that criticism is legitimate. He also noted that judges work hard to uphold the law, and personal attacks undermine their independence.

recent_articles.title: Reform UK may breach data laws with free energy bills competition | Reform UK | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Reform UK**, led by Nigel Farage, has launched a lottery offering free energy bills for a year to encourage voter participation.  Lawyers and data experts have raised concerns that the contest may violate UK data protection laws by collecting sensitive personal information like voting history and future intentions. The **Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO)** is investigating the legality of the competition, while **Reform UK** maintains its compliance with electoral laws and argues that the raffle complies with existing regulations.

recent_articles.title: BRS seeks explanation from Rohith Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** has issued a show-cause notice to former MLA Pilot Rohith Reddy, demanding an explanation for alleged drug consumption at his farmhouse meeting. The party general secretary in-charge of disciplinary matters, S. Bharath Kumar, stated that the incident is damaging the party's reputation and that BRS will oppose any link to illegal activities.  Mr. Kumar asked Mr. Reddy to provide a detailed explanation within seven days and stay away from party activities until a final decision is made.
